curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: appreciate measuring mass using arbitrary units in the environment.

mission.title: appreciate measuring mass using arbitrary units in the environment.

interactions.prompt: A mango balances with 3 bottle tops. Tap how many bottle tops measure the mango.
interactions.feedback: Yes! Three bottle tops balance the mango.
interactions.retryHint: Count the bottle tops on the other side of the balance.

interactions.prompt: Help the lion measure a book. Put 4 stones on the empty side until the balance is level.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap four stones one at a time to place them on the balance.
interactions.feedback: The book balances with 4 stones. Stones are useful units for measuring mass.
interactions.retryHint: Add one stone at a time. Stop when both sides are level.

interactions.prompt: A cup balances with 5 beans. Which sentence tells the measurement?
interactions.feedback: Great! We can say the cup is 5 beans in mass.
interactions.retryHint: Use the number of beans that makes the balance level.

interactions.prompt: Measure the small ball with bottle tops. Make the balance level using 2 bottle tops.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap two bottle tops one at a time to place them on the balance.
interactions.feedback: Correct! The small ball balances with 2 bottle tops.
interactions.retryHint: Try adding bottle tops slowly. Watch for the level balance.

interactions.prompt: At home, match each object to the units that balance it.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap an object, then tap its matching number of beans.
interactions.feedback: Wonderful measuring! Different objects can balance with different numbers of the same units.
interactions.retryHint: Read each balance carefully. Match the object to the number of beans opposite it.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. A lunch box balances with 6 stones. Tap the best way to describe it.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! You used stones as arbitrary units to measure mass.
interactions.retryHint: Name the units you used and count how many made the balance level.
